name: the Homelands
note: A zone of the disc for each race of racedefs past the game's, where it stands on the disc (no two in one cell of the grid). Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc; the content (start, people, quests) is tools/seed_race_homes.py's.

zones.name: West Plateau
zones.note: Hill Giant: the hill giants' plateau: 73 hill giants of the game stand in it (West Plateau, cell 3,1)

home.flavor: Hill Giants are towering folk of the West Plateau in the Homelands, whose young cross the sea to train beside the ogres of Oggok.

npcs.name: Elder Hrolmog
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a hill giant at the foot of the old steps

npcs.name: Grocer Bulka
npcs.note: the camp's grocer, an Oggok grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ognarr
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thundrik
npcs.note: sends a young giant who has done the starter quests to Oggok (the quest The Stone Way)

npcs.name: plateau skink
npcs.note: the starter hunt's skinks (a plains basilisk's body, small), at the plain's basilisks' spots west of the steps

zones.name: Kerra Isle
zones.note: Kerran: the kerrans' island, its village and sentries (Kerra Isle, cell 2,3)

home.flavor: Kerrans are a proud feline people of the stilt villages of Kerra Isle in the Homelands, whose young cross the sea to train in Qeynos.

npcs.name: Elder Ssharu
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a kerran priest's robe, on the village's landward side

npcs.name: Grocer Miyanne
npcs.note: the village's grocer by the water, a Qeynos grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Talhrin
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Raszhar
npcs.note: at the water's edge: sends a cub who has done the starter quests to Qeynos (the quest Across the Water)

npcs.name: isle crab
npcs.note: the starter hunt's crabs (a sandcrawler crab's body, small), on the sand north of the village

zones.name: Envar
zones.note: Jal'Raeth: the Rathe's Envar, where the game's own Jal'Raeth stand: 29 of them, commoners, nobles, channelers, knights and champions, among the ruins (Envar, cell 2,4). Added 2026-11-10, after the plan: the race joined after it.

home.flavor: The Jal'Raeth are a silent folk who drift in meditation round the old temple of Envar in the Homelands; Highbourne's scholars take them in.

npcs.name: Elder Ithrael
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a Jal'Raeth channeler, on the road before the temple's east door

npcs.name: Grocer Saelun
npcs.note: the order's grocer on the road's north side, a Highbourne grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Oravai
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Tavrin
npcs.note: at the temple's east door: sends one who has done the starter quests to Highbourne (the quest The Scholars' City)

npcs.name: ash grub
npcs.note: the starter hunt's grubs (a moth larva's body, small), in the dead hills where the east road ends

zones.name: Moss Mouth Cavern
zones.note: Goblin: a goblin cavern town: 87 goblins of the game, a blacksmith among them (Moss Mouth Cavern, cell 9,6)

zones.name: Aviak Village
zones.note: Aviak: the aviaks' savannah village: 173 aviaks of the game, a grocer and guards among them (Aviak Village, cell 4,10)

home.flavor: Aviaks are watchful bird folk of the savannah aeries in the Homelands, whose fledglings fly north to fight beside the barbarians of Halas.

npcs.name: Elder Kraawk
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in the high priest's robes

npcs.name: Grocer Skreel
npcs.note: the Roost's grocer, a Halas merchant's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Kreeal
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Windwhistle
npcs.note: sends a fledgling who has done the starter quests to Halas (the quest The Long Flight)

npcs.name: scrub rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the grave rats' spots south of the nests

zones.name: Cazic-Thule
zones.note: Lizardman: the Tae Ew lizardmen's temple in the swamp (Cazic-Thule, cell 7,15)

zones.name: Sylhilthis' Dwell
zones.note: Kappa: the kappa town of Odus: 179 kappa of the game, guards and a blacksmith (Sylhilthis' Dwell, cell 2,1)

home.flavor: Kappa are a hardy shelled river folk of Sylhilthis' Dwell in the Homelands, whose young go down the river to the halflings of Rivervale.

npcs.name: Elder Hoshuk
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a kappa shaman, on the sand south of the Dwell

npcs.name: Grocer Pemmi
npcs.note: the Dwell's grocer on the east sand, a Rivervale grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Oruko
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Kabbo
npcs.note: on the causeway: sends a young kappa who has done the starter quests to Rivervale (the quest Down the River)

npcs.name: marsh rat
npcs.note: the starter hunt's rats (a grave rat's body), on the shore where the causeway comes in

zones.name: Mayfly Glade
zones.note: Brownie: a glade (the brownies' own Salisearaneen stands in the Warrens' cell) (Mayfly Glade, cell 5,9)

zones.name: Misty Thicket
zones.note: Pixie: the bixies' thicket (Misty Thicket, cell 8,5)

zones.name: Twisted Tower
zones.note: Fairy: a faerie town: a blacksmith, druids and wizards of the game (Twisted Tower, cell 3,5)

zones.name: Blackburrow
zones.note: Gnoll: the gnolls' burrow: 124 gnolls of the game (Blackburrow, cell 6,6)

zones.name: Thedruk
zones.note: Orc: the Hatebone orcs' camp: 93 orcs of the game, a prophet among them (Thedruk, cell 9,4)

zones.name: The Warrens
zones.note: Kobold: the kobolds' tunnels: 114 of clan Kolbok (The Warrens, cell 4,4)

home.flavor: Kobolds are small, scaly diggers of the Warrens in the Homelands, whose pups trade their tunnel lore with the gnomes of Klick'Anon.

npcs.name: Elder Grikkis
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a high shaman's skull, by the cavern's stalls

npcs.name: Grocer Snivvet
npcs.note: the cavern's grocer at the stalls, a Klick'Anon grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Kraaz
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Ruknar
npcs.note: sends a pup who has done the starter quests to Klick'Anon (the quest The Deep Ways)

npcs.name: tunnel beetle
npcs.note: the starter hunt's beetles (a death beetle's body, small), at the cavern's west end

zones.name: Gerntar Mines
zones.note: Minotaur: the Rustel minotaurs' mines: 41 minotaurs of the game (Gerntar Mines, cell 6,13)

zones.name: The Vastly Deep
zones.note: Ratman: the ratmen's coast caves (The Vastly Deep, cell 5,3)

home.flavor: Ratmen are wiry, whiskered scavengers of the Vastly Deep's shore in the Homelands, whose young dig their way to the halls of Moradhim.

npcs.name: Elder Skritch
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a ratman spiritist, in the shore camp

npcs.name: Grocer Nibbla
npcs.note: the camp's grocer by the shacks, a Moradhim grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vessik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Ksarr
npcs.note: by the water: sends a young ratman who has done the starter quests to Moradhim (the quest Into the Deep Halls)

npcs.name: dune snake
npcs.note: the starter hunt's snakes (a green racer snake's body), on the shore east of the camp

zones.name: East Toxxulia
zones.note: Satyr: the satyrs' woods: 155 acolyte satyrs of the game (East Toxxulia, cell 3,2)

home.flavor: Satyrs are goat-legged revelers of the East Toxxulian woods in the Homelands, whose young dance off to the elven forest round Tethelin.

npcs.name: Elder Pannoch
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, an acolyte satyr, in the glade

npcs.name: Grocer Lyrrin
npcs.note: the glade's grocer, a faun maiden on its south side, a Tethelin grocer's food and drink

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Fennick
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Dorvan
npcs.note: sends a young satyr who has done the starter quests to its elven city (the quest The Elven Road)

npcs.name: glade spiderling
npcs.note: the starter hunt's spiderlings (a vineweb spiderling's body, small), east of the glade

zones.name: West Toxxulia
zones.note: Dryad: the forest dryads' woods (West Toxxulia, cell 2,2)

home.flavor: Dryads are spirits of the old trees of West Toxxulia in the Homelands, whose young go to tend the groves round Surefall Glade.

npcs.name: Elder Silverbough
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a forest dryad, on the lake's west shore

npcs.name: Grocer Willowmere
npcs.note: the grove's grocer by the water, a Surefall Glade grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ashleaf
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thornwyn
npcs.note: sends a young dryad who has done the starter quests to Qeynos or Surefall Glade (the quest Roots in the West)

npcs.name: bark beetle
npcs.note: the starter hunt's beetles (a giant scarab's body, small), in the woods west of the lake

zones.name: Tomb of Kings
zones.note: Skeleton: a crypt of the old kings (Tomb of Kings, cell 10,7)

zones.name: Guk
zones.note: Fungusman: the fungal folk's caverns (Guk's) (Guk, cell 12,14)

zones.name: South Barren Coast
zones.note: Gargoyle: the gargoyles' crags: 91 gargoyles of the game (South Barren Coast, cell 5,4)

home.flavor: Gargoyles are winged creatures of living stone from the crags of the South Barren Coast in the Homelands, who roost above Oggok.

npcs.name: Elder Gorrak
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a statue guardian, atop the crag

npcs.name: Grocer Skarn
npcs.note: the roost's grocer at the crag's foot, an Oggok grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vorth
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Kragg
npcs.note: on the crag's south slope: sends a gargoyle who has done the starter quests to Oggok (the quest Wings to Oggok)

npcs.name: crag bat
npcs.note: the starter hunt's bats (a vampire bat's body), round the crag's foot
